name: Spartan 7W Executive
summary: Sleek all-metal 1930s executive transport with a 450 hp Wasp Junior; only 34 were built and a dozen or so still fly.

engines: Big nine-cylinder Pratt & Whitney Wasp Junior radial under a smooth cowl
fuselage: Enclosed cabin seating four or five, with a raked windscreen
Retractable main gear with a tailwheel
tail: Large-area single fin and rudder with a big tailplane

tellTales: Sleek low-wing taildragger with a big radial engine and retractable gear
Enclosed cabin and polished all-metal skin
Large single fin and rudder on a graceful low-wing airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The Staggerwing is a biplane with fabric covering; the Spartan is an all-metal low-wing monoplane.
The Navion has an inline engine, a tricycle undercarriage and a sliding canopy; the Spartan has a big radial and a tailwheel.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
